name: Banestes S.A - Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo
summary: Banestes S.A - Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a multiple-service bank in Brazil. It operates through Financial; and Insurance and Other segments. The company operates through its portfolios of commercial, rural, industrial, real estate, foreign exchange, leasing, investment, and credit card administration; and in the areas of insurance and distribution, intermediation, and administration of third-party resources.
